description:
On September 17th, 2022, at around 2:09 am, an officer with Edmond Police Department in Oklahoma was on patrol when he saw a white vehicle traveling 50 MPH in a 35 MPH posted zone. The driver was also weaving in and out of the traffic as the officer activated his lights and conducted a traffic stop.

The suspect was arrested and later charged with DUI and 2x counts of Assault and Battery of a Police Officer.
